scientific_question: With resource geography, hereditary opcode availability, mutation rate, total resource budget, and movement held fixed, does executing SENSE_RESOURCE alter measured digital-population dynamics?
execution_mode: three verified batches of ten matched seeds each
interpretation_limit: The campaign supports only claims about executing the existing SENSE_RESOURCE opcode under this implemented center-patch environment. It does not establish adaptation, navigation, biological fitness, intelligence, cooperation, or open-ended evolution.
interval_note: Approximate paired 95% intervals use mean difference +/- t(29,0.975) times paired standard error and are descriptive for this computational campaign.
